description: Defines a template class 'VectorBuffer' implementing a fixed-capacity, vector-like buffer with manual memory management, move semantics, and optional destructor calls, used internally within the Chromium project.

classes.name: VectorBuffer
classes.description: A template class providing a manually managed, fixed-capacity buffer for objects of type T, optimized for trivial types and supporting manual destruction and move operations.

methods.name: VectorBuffer
methods.description: Default constructor, creates an empty buffer.

methods.name: VectorBuffer(size_t count)
methods.description: Constructor that allocates memory for 'count' elements of type T.

methods.name: VectorBuffer(VectorBuffer&& other) noexcept
methods.description: Move constructor that transfers ownership of the buffer from 'other'.

methods.name: ~VectorBuffer
methods.description: Destructor that frees the allocated buffer.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Move assignment operator that releases current buffer and takes ownership of 'other's buffer.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns pointer to the start of the buffer.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns pointer to one past the last element in the buffer.

methods.name: DestructRange
methods.description: Calls destructors on a range of elements if they are non-trivially destructible; no-op otherwise.

methods.name: MoveRange
methods.description: Static method to move a range of elements to a destination, optimized for trivially copyable, move-constructible, or non-movable types.
